sources.title: Legal SLM SFT - GitHub
sources.snippet: Legal SLM SFT Fine-tunes Llama-3.2-3B on-device (MLX, no cloud GPU) to analyze legal contract clauses in IRAC format, and rigorously compares precision (QLoRA vs full-precision LoRA) and alignment method (SFT vs DPO) against a zero-shot baseline — with a dual-metric eval (deterministic rubric + LLM judge) so neither score is trusted alone.
